Pattern gallery, page 5 of 8 (15-minute bars, MES / MNQ / MYM)

Purple circle = the detected pattern; yellow = its bars; light blue = the 5 bars after; arrow = entry at the next open to the close 5 bars later. EMA 8 red, 20 orange, 50 blue; VWAP light blue; dots = 3-bar swing points, diamonds = 10-bar swing points (only those already confirmed when the pattern appears). Momentum(14) below.

outside bar (bearish)

Rule: high > previous high AND low < previous low; direction of the close vs open. 38,350 occurrences on 15-minute bars across the three markets.

pin bar (bullish)

Rule: range >= avgR10 and one shadow >= 2/3 of range: long lower shadow bullish, long upper bearish. 19,419 occurrences on 15-minute bars across the three markets.

pin bar (bearish)

Rule: range >= avgR10 and one shadow >= 2/3 of range: long lower shadow bullish, long upper bearish. 15,868 occurrences on 15-minute bars across the three markets.

nr7 (neutral)

Rule: range smaller than each of the previous 6 ranges. 124,677 occurrences on 15-minute bars across the three markets.

tweezer (bullish)

Rule: lows within 0.05 x avgR10, bar1 down, bar2 up, close1 < EMA10 -> bullish bottom; highs mirror -> bearish top. 23,558 occurrences on 15-minute bars across the three markets.

tweezer (bearish)

Rule: lows within 0.05 x avgR10, bar1 down, bar2 up, close1 < EMA10 -> bullish bottom; highs mirror -> bearish top. 29,334 occurrences on 15-minute bars across the three markets.
